source_mqarray.source: Narkhede et al. MultimodalGasData, DOI 10.17632/zkwgkjkjn9.1; real MQ raw ADC archive copied into HazRob Tank central source snapshots
source_mqarray.source_row_offset_index: 0..6399 unique; published original source Serial Number restarts from 0 per class
source_mqarray.raw_units: source ADC, not tank kOhm Rs or Rs/R0
source_mqarray.split: five 320-consecutive-original-row blocks PER CLASS, each held-out once; train on four other blocks/class and embargo 20 rows on either side of heldout block; no source-day/device/session IDs
source_mqarray.model: V6 ClassicalLearningV6.fitSoftmax; 600 iterations, learning rate 0.16, L2 0.003; training-only standardization
limitations: Label categories are original source classes, NOT four distinct chemically pure analytes.
No known reference gas ppm at any row; do not use for concentration model training or safety detection limits.
Serial Number resets per source class, no independent measurement session IDs. 6400 rows likely correlated time sequences; five row blocks per class do not prove independent test days/devices.
No imputed MQ4/MQ9. Source electronics/RL/R0 unknown so no direct Tank sensor interchangeability.

source_mq135_real_known_gas.source: UCI1081 Gas sensor array low-concentration; 90 source exposures of six gases x three known concentration labels (50,100,200 ppb) x 5 repeats; use ONLY physical MQ135 channel from its ten-source array
source_mq135_real_known_gas.sensor_used: MQ135 ONLY; source ten array NOT treated as Tank MQ array
source_mq135_real_known_gas.classifier: Same V6 Softmax as N05, 800 iterations, LR 0.15, L2 0.005, training-only scaler
source_mq135_real_known_gas.classification_holdout: one whole concentration level left out 60 source rows train, 30 source rows test, repeated x3
source_mq135_real_known_gas.concentration_method: TRUE GAS ORACLE CONDITIONED: for each gas, derive two training-concentration mean original MQ135 endpoint/baseline ratios, invert log-ratio versus log-concentration using SourceNumericsV6.estimateUnseen; never uses heldout source concentration in fit
limitations: This regression uses TRUE gas identity provided in advance (oracle), not a realistic unknown-gas-to-ppm pipeline.
Only one MQ model (MQ135) is present among installed Tank MQ array, and no physical Tank Rs/R0 or shared electrical characterization is available.
The original ppb exposures are declared below sensing device's reliable detection limit; a finite interpolation is NOT physical validation of ppm sensitivity.
A significant number of extrapolation estimates are wildly implausible; do not use as operational ppm, exposure warnings or G3 evidence.
Original source acquisitions do not prove independent days/devices, so results only establish an exploratory research baseline.

n06_previous_work_note: An earlier N06 partial instant V6 routing change exists in the branch; this MQ benchmark did not alter Android instantaneous, approved-session or report code.
